verdict.rationale: Channel3 is an API-first product, so it runs headlessly by design. Its official CLI is documented as calling the API "from a terminal or script" and supports format selection and JMESPath field extraction for pipelines. It also ships an SDK with async calls and uses simple API keys with no OAuth flow, all of which suit unattended automation. Missing for 10: explicit CI documentation (e.g., pipeline examples, environment-variable auth, exit-code behavior) and independent hands-on corroboration of scripted or CI use.
